hero_body: From intimate haldi mornings to grand mandap ceremonies, we dress your day in marigold, rose and light — across Gujarat and wherever your celebration takes us.
whatsapp_prefill: Hi! I'd like to enquire about event decoration.
services_title: One team for every rite and celebration
services_body: Every function has its own mood. We design, source and style each one — flowers, fabric, structure and light — so it feels unmistakably yours.
service_wedding_desc: Mandap, stage and entrance décor built around your rituals and colours.
service_haldi_desc: Bright marigold and floral settings for a joyful morning ceremony.
service_mehndi_desc: Playful, colourful backdrops and seating for the mehndi function.
service_sangeet_desc: Stage, lighting and dance-floor décor with energy to spare.
service_reception_desc: Elegant stage and table settings for the evening celebration.
service_corporate_desc: Launches, temple functions and festival décor at any scale.
work_body: A living gallery of real events — photos and films — is on its way here.
process_title: From first message to the last flower
process_step1_desc: Tell us your dates, venue and vision over WhatsApp or the form.
process_step2_desc: We plan the look, palette and layout, and share a clear quote.
process_step3_desc: Fresh flowers, fabric and props are sourced and prepared for your day.
process_step4_desc: Our team sets up on time and stays until every detail is perfect.
about_title: A family that has decorated Gujarat's celebrations for years
about_body1: Rooted in Mehsana, we began with garlands for neighbourhood weddings and grew into a full décor team trusted for functions of every size.
about_body2: We travel across Gujarat and beyond for destination events, bringing the same care to a home haldi as to a thousand-guest reception.
testimonial1_quote: They turned our mandap into something out of a dream. Every flower was fresh on the morning of the wedding.
testimonial2_quote: We booked them for the haldi and ended up giving them the whole wedding. The team simply does not stop until it is right.
testimonial3_quote: Our reception stage was the first thing every guest photographed. Worth every rupee.
contact_body: Tell us a little about your celebration and we will get back to you with ideas and a clear quote.
form_note: This opens WhatsApp with your details filled in — nothing is sent until you press send there.
